login.title: Sign in

fields.emailOrUsernameHint: Sign in with your e-mail address. If none is stored for you, use your username.

errors.requiredEmailOrUsername: Please enter your e-mail address or username

login.lockedHint: Your access is locked. Contact HR or your supervisor.
login.captchaFailed: The security check could not be loaded. Reload the page or try another network.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your e-mail address or username. If an e-mail address is stored for you, you get a link for a new password.
forgotPassword.sentHint: If an e-mail address is stored for this account, a link arrives shortly (valid for one hour). Without an address no mail comes: HR then gives you a new activation sheet in person.

updatePassword.linkInvalid: This link is invalid or has already been used
updatePassword.linkInvalidHint: Mail programs sometimes open links in advance, which uses them up. Request a new link.
updatePassword.title: Set a new password

nav.leaveUnsaved: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.enrollHint: An authenticator app is required for this account. Scan the QR code with an app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy or 1Password, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.manual: Can't scan it? Enter this code manually:
mfa.challengeHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.noFactor: No verified authenticator app found for this account.

errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.duplicate: An entry with this name or key already exists.
errors.inUse: This entry is still in use and cannot be removed.
errors.invalid: A value is missing or not valid.
errors.network: No connection to the server. Please try again.
errors.overlap: The period overlaps an existing entry.
errors.gone: This refers to something that no longer exists.

profile.title: My profile
profile.adminManaged: Name and position are managed by an admin.
profile.photoByHr: Name, position and photo are managed by HR.
profile.showBirthdayHint: Day and month appear in the directory and on the start page. Switched off, only HR sees your birthday.
profile.ssoNoPassword: Your account signs in with Microsoft only; it has no password and cannot have one.
profile.passwordMustDiffer: The new password must differ from the current one
profile.remindTrainings: Trainings that are due soon, expired or missing (people who lead teams also get one line per day)
profile.emailTooHint: One summary a day, only if something is still unread by then.
profile.timeZoneHint: Times of messages, changes and uploads are shown in this zone. Dates without a time stay as entered.
profile.messageSwitchesHint: Which messages put a line in the bell. Mentions always arrive. A conversation you muted stays silent anyway.

messageSwitch.team_post: New posts in teams I follow
messageSwitch.team_comment: Replies in posts I take part in

push.title: Push notifications
push.hint: Important things appear as a notification on the device, even when COMPASS is closed: mentions, comments, new posts in groups you follow, assignments and tasks waiting for you. Reminders stay in the bell and the e-mail.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for COMPASS in the browser.

state.unsupported: This browser cannot receive push notifications here: a private window, a very old browser or an address without https. Use a normal window in Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
state.dev_server: This is the development version of COMPASS (dev server). It has no background service, so there is no push here. To try it, open the built app: http://localhost:5176.
state.no_worker: The COMPASS background service has not started in this browser, and push needs it. Reload the page. If that does not help: allow cookies and site data for COMPASS in the site settings (lock icon next to the address).
state.ios_install: On iPhone and iPad push works only in the app on the home screen: in Safari tap Share > Add to Home Screen, open COMPASS from there and switch it on here.
state.not_configured: Push is not set up on the server yet.
state.denied: Notifications are blocked for COMPASS in the browser. Allow them in the site settings (lock icon next to the address) and reload the page.

waiting.permission: Please answer the browser's question: allow "Show notifications". If you see no question, click the bell icon at the right of the address bar (Edge often shows it only there).
waiting.subscribe: Connecting to the browser's push service …

push.serviceTimeout: The browser's push service does not answer. The network or a company policy may block it; try another network or browser.
push.quietHint: During these hours no device buzzes. What arrives then stays in the bell and is not pushed afterwards; the window may span midnight.

grantErrors.not_allowed: You cannot give this person a login (not yourself; a person holding the Admin role only as an admin).

login.grantMail: Send the link to set a password to {{email}}
login.grantMailNone: Link by e-mail (no e-mail address stored)
login.grantSheet: Issue an activation sheet with QR code (hand over in person)
login.grantSso: The person signs in with Microsoft ({{email}}); there is no password.
login.grantUsername: The person signs in with the username {{username}}.
login.grantEmail: The person signs in with the e-mail address {{email}}.
login.lockExplain: The person can no longer sign in, open sessions end at once and push notifications are switched off. Password, second factor and all data stay; unlocking undoes it.
login.throttled: Waiting after repeated wrong passwords, until {{time}}
login.throttleCleared: The account can sign in again.
login.mailFailed: The e-mail could not be sent ({{error}}). An activation sheet follows.
login.notYours: You cannot change your own access here, nor an admin's unless you are one.
login.revokeConfirm: The account is deleted (password, second factor, sessions, devices). The person and their history stay in the directory; a login can be given again later.
login.sheetConfirm: The current password and the second factor are deleted and all sessions end. The person activates the access again with the sheet. Hand it over in person only.
login.sheetOnce: The code is shown only now. Print it or hand it over directly.
login.sheetStep1: Scan the QR code with your phone (or open the address below and type username and code).
login.sheetStep2: Choose a password with at least 10 characters.
login.sheetStep3: Set up the authenticator app (e.g. Microsoft or Google Authenticator).
login.sheetStep4: From then on you sign in with your e-mail address (or the username if none is stored), password and the app code.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Switches of the platform and its modules

admin.revokeText: The person stays in the directory but can no longer sign in. This cannot be undone here.
admin.emailLocked: The address of a person with a login cannot be changed here.
admin.signInSwitchToSso: The password is deleted and sign-in goes through Microsoft. Sessions end.
admin.signInSwitchToPassword: The Microsoft link is removed; the person needs a new password. Sessions end.
admin.deleteTeamText: Its posts and conversations are deleted with it.
admin.teamUsesHint: Where this team can be picked.
admin.deleteRoleText: People with only this role lose its rights.

email.title: Email
email.description: SMTP server, sender and the daily digest of unread notifications.

admin.addPersonHint: The person has no login yet: give one in the next dialog ("Give login") if needed.
admin.teamUseManaged: This team is an {{use}}; it is kept on its own page.

activate.codeInvalid: Username or code is wrong, or the code has expired or was used already. HR can issue a new sheet.
activate.codeRequired: Enter the code from the activation sheet
activate.homeScreenHint: Tip for phones: add the app to the home screen first and open this page from the app. The app has its own sign-in, separate from the browser.
activate.intro: Choose a password for your access. Then you set up the authenticator app as the second factor.
activate.title: Activate your access

people.emailRequired: Enter an e-mail address first for the Microsoft sign-in.
people.loginGranted: Account created, the link to set a password was sent.
people.loginGrantedSso: Account created. The person signs in with Microsoft; no e-mail is sent.

emailSettings.subtitle: One daily summary per person: only what is still unread the same day (reminders, assignments, mentions, comments, step changes).
emailSettings.transportHint: How the mails leave: SMTP or a mailbox connected by a module (the sender is that mailbox).
emailSettings.enabledHint: Nothing is sent until it is on; the test mail works anyway.
emailSettings.usernameHint: Leave empty for a relay without login.
emailSettings.passwordSet: A password is stored. Leave empty to keep it.
emailSettings.noneWarning: Without encryption the mails cross the network in clear text. Only sensible for an internal relay or tests.
emailSettings.brandColorHint: Top border, buttons and links of the mails; empty = red. The logo is the app's mail-logo.png.
emailSettings.appUrlHint: Links in the mails start with it, e.g. https://app.example.com
emailSettings.dispatchUrlHint: The database reaches the send-emails function here (every 15 minutes it checks whether the daily summary is due). Empty = no automatic sending.
emailSettings.testHint: “Send test mail” saves the settings first.
emailSettings.digestHint: At most one mail per person and day. Reading a message in the app means no mail for it. If sending fails it is retried every 15 minutes.
emailSettings.languageHint: People have no language of their own here.

filters.searchMany: Type to search, select one or more
filters.title: Filter: {{label}}

offline.banner: You're offline. Reconnect to continue working.
offline.serverTrouble: Having trouble reaching the server. Changes may not be saved - retrying automatically.
offline.queuedCount: {{count}} worksheet entries waiting for a connection.

team.autoFollowAdminOnly: Only an administrator can switch on automatic following.
team.autoFollowHint: Everybody who reads the group gets its posts, unless they choose otherwise. Only an administrator switches this on; it goes off when the group is limited to its members.
team.mentions: Who may mention the whole team
team.mentionsHint: @Team reaches every member, also those who muted the group. Use it for what everybody must know.
team.handOverConfirm: Hand the ownership of this team over? You stay a member but can no longer add members or change the settings.
team.handOverHint: Only a member who can sign in can take over. Group managers (HR) can set owners at any time.
team.settingsOwnerOnly: Only an owner can change the settings of this team.
team.settingsHint: Where the group is used (tasks, trainings, …) is set under Admin > Groups.
team.memberRemoveConfirm: Remove this person from the team?
team.membersHint: Membership also gives the members the team rights of their roles (tasks, trainings, positions of this team). Every change is logged.

users.manage: Manage users: give a login, maintain name, position, supervisor and deputy (not roles or sign-in method)

teams.create: Create my own teams (I become their owner and maintain their members)
teams.manage: Manage teams: create, edit and delete teams, their members and owners

gate.unavailable: The app could not be opened right now.
